description: Single beneficiary with MAGI exactly at the top-tier limit ('greater than or equal to'): top tier.
worked:
Premium year 2025; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2023 tax return (two years back): 500,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2025 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the individual tax return column (single, head of household, qualifying surviving spouse, married filing separately and lived apart all year): 500,000 is greater than or equal to 500,000.
Part B: standard premium 185.00 + income-related adjustment 443.90 = total monthly premium 628.90.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 85.80 (added to the plan premium).
